newsitem.title: USA: Kodak consumer imaging oper income rose 3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Kodak consumer imaging oper income rose 3 pct.

text.p: Eastman Kodak Co said Tuesday that sales for its Consumer Imaging segment rose a total of 13 percent in third quarter, and earnings from operations for the segment rose three percent in the quarter.

Consumer imaging sales in the U.S. increased 18 percent and outside the U.S. sales increased 10 percent. Kodak said earnings grew slower than sales because of increased advertising and promotional costs, due in part to the summer Olympics, and because earnings for photofinishing operations outside the U.S. were lower.
Worldwide, commercial imaging sales gained five percent, the company said,
